description: Default capability set for CorpusMind desktop. Issue 10 fix: the shell-spawn/fs-write grants were broader than this file's own 'minimal permissions' claim — the webview never spawns shells or writes files (the Rust side owns the sidecar and Ollama lifecycle, which is not IPC-gated), so shell-spawn and fs-mutating permissions are removed entirely and fs reads are scoped to app data + common user folders (dialog-picked paths are auto-allowed by the dialog plugin).
